{{Quote|Allow me to present my grandson, Dashan. He is as adept as I was when I was four.|Usan Joyl|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Dashan Joyl''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the grandson of the infamous [[Usan Joyl]], a con artist and an identity forger.<ref name="MK" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> both Joyl and his grandfather were captured and held prisoner by corrupt [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] in the lower levels of [[Vandor-3]]'s [[Caridan]] [[Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat|animal exhibit]], where Thaal conducted his criminal activities across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Even as they were imprisoned, Joyl's grandfather was used for his identity-forging talents so that Thaal could retire from the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] with the new identity of [[Stavin Thaal|Thadley Biolan]].<ref name="MK" />

When [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] squad, began their investigation into Thaal's guilt regarding his involvement with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]], the Joyls were freed by Wraiths [[Myri Antilles]] and [[Trey Courser]]. When both [[Bhindi Drayson]] and [[Sharr Latt]]'s units of Wraith Squadron were discovered throughout the animal exhibit, the Joyls joined them in escaping and holing up at [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]]. They spent several [[Standard day|days]] there, and during this time, Joyl's grandfather told the Wraiths about Thaal's transformation into Thadley Biolan, something that helped them along and conclude their mission later on. The Joyls later joined the Wraiths in escaping Vandor-3 by shuttle escorted by the former [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], at which point both Duros had gained their freedom.<ref name="MK" />
